results.summary: Arogya Sanjeevani Policy from Bajaj General is a one-year hospitalisation indemnity cover with sum insured from Rs 1,00,000 to Rs 25,00,000 on an individual or floater basis. It carries a 5% co-pay on every claim, room rent capped at 2% of sum insured up to Rs 5,000 a day, a 36-month pre-existing disease wait and a 5% cumulative bonus per claim-free year up to 50%.

facts.label: Portability
facts.value: Yes. The insured can port to another insurer, applying at least 30 days but not earlier than 60 days before renewal; waiting periods are reduced by the years of prior continuous cover, up to the previous sum insured and accrued bonus.
facts.display: Yes, with waiting-period credit; apply 30 to 60 days before renewal
facts.note: Migration to other Bajaj General health products also carries waiting-period credit.
facts.quote: The Insured Beneficiary will have the option to port the Certificate of Insurance to other insurers as per extant Guidelines related to Portability. ... The waiting periods specified in Section 6 shall be reduced by the number of continuous preceding years of coverage of the Insured Beneficiary under the previous Health Insurance Policy ... Portability benefit will be offered to the extent of sum of previous sum insured and accrued bonus ... at least 30 days before, but not earlier than 60 days from the Policy renewal date ... The Insured Beneficiary will have the option to migrate the Certificate of Insurance to other health insurance products/plans offered by the company

facts.label: Cancellation by you
facts.value: On 7 days' written notice, the unexpired premium is refunded pro rata, provided no claim was made in the policy year; medical examination costs are deducted if cover has started. The insurer may cancel for misrepresentation, non-disclosure or fraud on 15 days' notice with no refund.

results.summary: Arogya Sanjeevani Policy, Go Digit is a one-year indemnity health policy on an individual or family floater basis, with sum insured from Rs 50,000 to Rs 3 crore and treatment in India only. results.summary: Arogya Sanjeevani is Niva Bupa's one-year hospitalisation indemnity policy for individuals or families, with sum insured from INR 50,000 to 10 lakh. results.summary: Criti Care is an individual critical illness policy from Bajaj General with five sections (Cancer, Cardiovascular, Kidney, Neuro, Transplants and Sensory Organs) covering 43 conditions, of which at least one section must be chosen. It pays a lump sum of 25% of the section Sum Assured for a Category A condition and 100% for a Category B condition, after a 180 or 120 day initial waiting period and a 0, 7 or 15 day survival period.

results.summary: Digit Health Care Plus Policy is a modular indemnity health policy from Go Digit General Insurance with 30 sections the buyer chooses, led by a Hospitalization Cover (accident and illness, or accident only) with sum insured from Rs. 10,000 to unlimited. Waiting periods, room rent limit, deductible and co-pay are chosen by the buyer, cover is India only unless extended for extra premium, and policy terms run 1 to 5 years.

results.summary: Easy Health is an HDFC ERGO indemnity health policy sold in Standard and Exclusive plans, on an individual or family floater basis, with sum insured from Rs. 1 lakh to Rs. 50 lakh and cover in India only. It has a 30-day initial wait, 24 months for listed illnesses, 36 months for pre-existing diseases, and a 10% yearly cumulative bonus up to 100% irrespective of claims.

sum_insured_options: Rs. 1 lakh to Rs. 50 lakh (Standard up to 15 lakh; Exclusive 3 to 50 lakh)
copay: No zone co-payment for treatment in a higher tier city
filter_values.copay_display: No zone co-payment for treatment in a higher tier city
deductible: Only the standard definition of Deductible is printed; no deductible amount for this product is stated.
filter_values.deductible_display: Only the standard definition of Deductible is printed; no deductible amount for this product is stated.
filter_values.room_rent_display: Hospital room rent or boarding is listed as a covered in-patient expense, but no daily room limit or room category is printed, and the CIS sub-limit list does not mention room rent. A daily cash of Rs.500 to Rs.1000 per day (maximum Rs.3,000 to Rs.6,000) is paid for choosing shared accommodation in a Network Hospital if hospitalisation exceeds 48 hours.

facts.label: Pre-existing disease waiting period
facts.display: 36 months

facts.label: Portability
facts.value: Yes. You can port the whole policy, with all family members, to another insurer by applying at least 30 days but not earlier than 60 days before the renewal date, and keep the accrued continuity benefits in waiting periods.

facts.note: Migration to other HDFC ERGO products is also allowed by applying at least 30 days before renewal.

facts.label: Cancellation by you
facts.value: You can cancel with 7 days' written notice and get a pro-rata refund of premium for the unexpired period, but no refund if any claim has been admitted or any benefit availed.
facts.display: Pro-rata refund for the unexpired period; none if a claim was admitted
facts.note: For instalment policies with an admissible claim, future instalments of the year are adjusted in the claim and no refund applies that year.
facts.quote: The Policyholder may cancel this Policy by giving 7 days’ written notice and in such an event, the Company shall refund to the Insured a pro-rata premium for the unexpired Policy Period. ... no refunds of premium shall be made in respect of Cancellation where, any claim has been admitted or any benefit has been availed by the Insured Person under the Policy. ... In case of admissible claim under the Policy, future instalment for the current Policy Year will be adjusted in the claim amount and no refund of any premium will be applicable during the Policy Year.

results.summary: Global Health Care is a one-year individual health indemnity policy from Bajaj General with two plans, Imperial and Imperial Plus, each pairing hospital cover in India in rupees (INR 3,750,000 to 37,500,000) with cover worldwide outside India in US dollars (USD 100,000 to 1,000,000), with or without the USA. In India room rent and ICU are paid at actual with 60 days pre- and 180 days post-hospitalisation, while abroad a single private room applies and only Imperial Plus adds out-patient, evacuation and repatriation benefits.

results.summary: Health Ensure is a Bajaj General hospitalisation indemnity policy on an individual or family floater basis, for 1, 2 or 3 years, with sum insured up to Rs. 10 lakh and room rent capped at 1% of sum insured up to INR 5,000 per day. Pre-existing diseases wait 24 months, claims are handled in-house without a TPA, and Zone B premium payers treated in a Zone A city pay a 20% co-payment.

results.summary: Health Guard is a Bajaj General indemnity health policy sold as Individual or Family Floater in Silver, Gold and Platinum plans, for 1, 2 or 3 years, covering treatment within India only. It pays pre-hospitalisation for 60 days and post-hospitalisation for 90 days, has a 30-day initial waiting period, a 36-month pre-existing disease waiting period and a 24-month specific illness waiting period, and offers maternity cover only in Gold and Platinum after 72 months.

results.summary: ManipalCigna Lifetime Health India Plan is an indemnity health policy covering treatment in India only, with Sum Insured1 of Rs 50 Lacs to 300 Lacs, individual or family floater, for 1, 2 or 3 years and renewable for life. Pre-existing diseases and listed illnesses wait 24 months, the used Base Sum Insured1 is restored unlimited times a year, there is no standard co-payment or disease sub-limit, and maternity and OPD are excluded in the base cover.

Associated Medical Expenses shall include nursing charges, operation theatre charges, fees of Medical Practitioner surgeon/anesthetist/Specialist, excluding cost of pharmacy and consumables, cost of implants and medical devices, cost of diagnostics conducted within the same Hospital where the Insured Person has been admitted. results.summary: ManipalCigna Infinix is an India-only individual or family floater health indemnity policy with Core, Now and Active variants, covering hospital stays of 2 hours or more, with a Rs 10 lakh or Unlimited Base Sum Insured outside the Active variant and lifelong renewal. A co-payment of 10% or 25% applies outside the chosen hospital package, the default room is a single private AC room, and the Core plan waiting periods are 30 days, 36 months for pre-existing diseases and 36 months for specified diseases.

results.summary: My Family Complete is a Bajaj General indemnity health policy that covers family members and pet dogs or cats under one contract, on an individual or floater basis, with sums insured from Rs 5 lakh to Rs 5 crore and terms of 1 to 5 years. It pays hospitalisation in a single private AC room with 60 days pre and 90 days post hospitalisation, a 25% cumulative bonus up to 100% and sum insured reinstatement, after waiting periods of 30 days, 24 months for listed conditions and 36 months for pre-existing diseases.

facts.label: Cancellation by you
facts.value: Cancel with 7 days' written notice. An annual policy gets a pro-rata refund for the unexpired period if no claim was made in the policy year; a multi-year policy gets a full refund for years not started and pro-rata for the current year if claim free. Medical examination costs are deducted.
facts.display: Pro-rata refund for the unexpired period, if no claim in the policy year
facts.note: Instalment premium policies: pro-rata refund if no claim in the policy year. No refund when the insurer cancels for misrepresentation, non-disclosure or fraud.

Annual Policy: The premium refund for the unexpired risk period will be on a pro-rata basis, provided no claim has been made during the policy year. ... For any Policy Year where the risk date has not yet started, the premium will be refunded without any deduction. o For any Policy Year where the risk has started, the premium will be refunded on a pro-rata basis for that Policy Year, provided no claim has been made during the Policy Year and in full for future Policy Years. ... expenses incurred by the Company on medical examination of the Insured Persons will also be deducted before refunding of premium.

facts.label: No-claim or cumulative bonus

results.summary: My Health Companion is an outpatient-only indemnity policy from Bajaj General with four plans, Start, Smart, Prime and Elite, carrying OPD wallets of Rs 5,000, 10,000, 15,000 and 25,000 for in-clinic consultations, prescribed diagnostics, tele consultations, accidental OPD, an annual health check-up and diet and emotional wellness sessions (dental OPD in Elite only). Hospitalisation, room rent and day care are excluded, treatment must be taken in India, and illness claims carry a 30-day initial waiting period and a 12-month pre-existing disease wait.

results.summary: My Infinite Care is a Bajaj General individual or family floater health indemnity policy with a Sum Insured of 5 lakh, 10 lakh or Unlimited, for 1 to 5 years, with entry from 3 months and lifetime renewal. It pays a single private AC room, ICU at actuals, 90 days pre and 180 days post hospitalisation, unlimited Sum Insured reinstatement and a 50% a year cumulative bonus up to 100% irrespective of claims, with 30-day, 24-month specific and 36-month pre-existing disease waiting periods.

facts.display: At least 48 hours before planned admission; within 24 hours of emergency admission
facts.note: For benefits that depend on an accepted in-patient claim: within 7 days of discharge. Claim documents are due within 15 days of the insurer's request or of discharge, whichever is earlier. The prospectus also asks for contact at least 7 days before an event that may give rise to a claim.
facts.quote: If any treatment for which a claim may be made is to be taken and that treatment requires Hospitalisation: | Immediately and in any event at least 48 hours prior to the Insured Person’s admission. ... If any treatment for which a claim may be made is to be taken and that treatment requires Hospitalisation in an Emergency: | Within 24 hours of the Insured Person’s admission to Hospital. ... For all benefits which are contingent on Our prior acceptance of a claim under Section 1)a): | Within 7 days of the Insured Person’s discharge post-hospitalisation. ... within 15 days of the earlier of Our request or the Insured Person’s discharge from Hospitalisation or completion of treatment ... Please contact HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company at least 7 days prior to an event which might give rise to a claim.

facts.label: Claim settlement time promised
facts.value: The insurer settles or rejects a reimbursement claim within 15 days from receipt of claim intimation; delay attracts interest at 2% above the bank rate from the date of intimation.
facts.display: Within 15 days of claim intimation (reimbursement)
facts.note: Interest at 2% above the bank rate if payment is delayed. CIS: cashless pre-authorisation decision within 1 hour; final bill authorisation within 3 hours of the hospital's discharge request.

facts.label: Portability
facts.value: Yes. The whole policy can be ported to another insurer by applying at least 30 days, but not earlier than 60 days, before the renewal date, with accrued continuity benefits in waiting periods.
facts.display: Yes, apply 30 to 60 days before renewal; waiting-period credit carried over
facts.note: Migration to another HDFC ERGO product is also allowed, applying at least 30 days before renewal.
facts.quote: The Insured Person will have the option to port the Policy to other insurers by applying to such Insurer to port the entire policy along with all the members of the family, if any, at least 30 days before, but not earlier than 60 days from the policy renewal date as per IRDAI guidelines related to Portability. If such person is presently covered and has been continuously covered without any lapses under any health insurance policy with an Indian General/Health insurer, the proposed Insured Person will get the accrued continuity benefits in waiting periods as per IRDAI guidelines on portability. ... The Insured Person will have the option to migrate the Policy to other health insurance products/plans offered by the Company by applying for Migration of the policyatleast30 days before the policy renewal date

results.summary: ManipalCigna ProHealth Prime (Protect and Advantage plans) is a one-year indemnity health policy with Base Sum Insured from Rs 3 Lacs (Protect) or Rs 5 Lacs (Advantage) to Rs 100 Lacs, room up to a Single Private AC Room, 60 and 180 days pre and post hospitalisation, and 100% restoration of the Base Sum Insured unlimited times a year. Pre-existing diseases wait 36 months (24 months from Rs 7.5 Lacs), listed conditions 24 months, the cumulative bonus is 25% a year up to 200% irrespective of claims, and treatment in a higher zone than the one paid for carries a 10% or 20% co-pay.

facts.label: Cancellation by you
facts.value: You can cancel with 7 days' written notice. If no claim has been made, the premium is refunded in proportion to the unexpired days; if a claim has been made, there is no refund.
facts.display: Pro-rata refund for unexpired days if no claim; no refund after a claim
facts.note: The insurer may cancel for misrepresentation, non-disclosure or fraud on 15 days' notice with no refund.
facts.quote: The policyholder may cancel this policy by giving 7 days written notice at any time during the term ... If no claim has been made during the policy period, a proportionate refund of the premium will be issued based on the number of unexpired days. ... If a claim has been made during the Policy period, no refund will be given to the Policyholder.

facts.label: Where it covers
facts.value: India only, except the optional Freedom package's Worldwide Emergency Hospitalization with Outpatient Cover. Claims are settled in India in rupees.
facts.display: India; worldwide emergencies only with the Freedom option
facts.note: Air ambulance cover is for transport within India.
facts.quote: The geographical scope of this policy applies to events within India other than for D.III.4.ii Worldwide Emergency Hospitalization with Outpatient Cover under Freedom optional package (if opted) and which are specifically covered in the Policy Schedule. However all admitted or payable claims shall be settled in India in Indian rupees. ... transfer between healthcare facilities within India by an Air Ambulance

facts.label: Free-look period
facts.display: 30 days
facts.note: New individual policies only, not renewals or ported policies. Refund less proportionate risk premium, medical examination and stamp duty costs, within 7 days of the request.

facts.label: Grace period
facts.display: 30 days
facts.note: Instalment premiums: 30 days for half-yearly and quarterly, 15 days for monthly mode.
facts.quote: in no case later than the Grace Period of 30 days from the expiry of the Policy. ... Grace Period of 30 days would be given for Half-yearly and Quarterly mode of payment and grace period of 15 days for monthly mode of payment

facts.label: Entry age
facts.value: Minimum entry age is 91 days for children and 18 years for adults; there is no maximum entry age.
facts.display: 91 days (children), 18 years (adults); no upper limit
facts.note: From the prospectus. Children from 91 days to 17 years are covered only if a parent is the proposer; children up to 25 years can be in a floater.
facts.quote: The minimum entry age under this policy is 91 days for children and 18 years for adults. There is no limit for entry under this policy.

facts.label: Premium payment options
facts.display: Single (annual), half-yearly, quarterly or monthly
facts.note: Loading on premium: monthly 5.50%, quarterly 3.50%, half-yearly 2.50%. The prospectus lists 'Single, Yearly, Half yearly, Quarterly and Monthly'. Instalments only for a one-year tenure.
facts.quote: Premium can be paid on Single, Half yearly, Quarterly and Monthly basis.

facts.quote:

c) Person paying Zone III premium
i) Can avail treatment in Zone III, without any Co-pay.

results.summary: ManipalCigna ProHealth Select is an indemnity health policy in two variants, (A) for affinity partners with sum insured from Rs 0.5 lakh and (B) for agency, broking and direct channels from Rs 2 lakh, up to Rs 25 lakh, for individuals or families. Room rent is capped at 2% of base sum insured up to Rs 3,000, pre-existing diseases wait 36 months, listed illnesses 24 months, and a 5% yearly cumulative bonus up to 100% is given regardless of claims.

copay: None by default; 10% or 20% if treated in a costlier zone than the premium zone

facts.label: Plans and variants
facts.display: ProHealth Select (A) and ProHealth Select (B)
facts.note: (A) is sold through affinity partners (corporate agents), (B) through agency, broking and direct channels. Several optional covers (voluntary co-pay, health check-up, worldwide emergency cover, disease specific sub-limits, health maintenance benefit) exist only in (A).
facts.quote: The policy is available under 2 variants as detailed below: ProHealth Select (A) available to Affinity Partners (Corporate Agents) ProHealth Select (B) available to Agency, Broking and Direct Channels

facts.label: Policy term
facts.value: One, two or three years.
facts.display: 1, 2 or 3 years
facts.note: From the prospectus; the wording refers to Policy Periods of two/three years. Instalment premiums are not available for terms over 1 year.
facts.quote: You can buy the policy for one, two or three continuous years at the option of the Insured.

facts.label: Claim intimation deadline
facts.value: Planned hospitalisation must be notified at least 48 hours before admission; emergency hospitalisation within 24 hours of admission.
facts.display: 48 hours before planned admission; within 24 hours of emergency admission
facts.note: Worldwide Emergency Cover: within 48 hours of admission abroad. Hospital stays beyond 10 days not intimated within 10 days of admission may attract an extra 10% co-payment. Reimbursement documents are due within 15 days of discharge.
facts.quote: Planned Hospitalization- You/the Insured Person will intimate such admission at least 48 hours prior to the planned date of admission. ... Emergency Hospitalization- You /the Insured Person will intimate such admission within 24 hours of such admission.

Copy of FIR/Panchnama / Police Inquest Report (if conducted) in case of Accident

facts.note: Reimbursement claim list for in-patient hospitalisation. Documents are due within 15 days of discharge (cashless claim documents from the hospital within 30 days). facts.label: Claim settlement time promised
facts.value: The insurer settles or rejects a claim within 15 days from submission of the necessary claim documents, with interest at 2% above bank rate for delay. Cashless pre-authorisation within 1 hour and final discharge authorisation within 3 hours of complete documents.
facts.display: 15 days from the last necessary document; cashless approval within 1 hour, discharge within 3 hours
facts.note: Health Maintenance Benefit claims: within 5 days, not later than 15 days.
facts.quote: The Company shall settle or reject the claim, as the case may be, within 15 days (other than cashless) from date of submission of necessary claim documents. ... at a rate 2% above the bank rate ... facts.display: 60 months

facts.label: Portability
facts.value: Yes. The whole policy, with all family members, can be ported to another insurer by applying at least 30 days before, but not earlier than 60 days from, the renewal date; continuously covered persons get accrued continuity benefits in waiting periods as per IRDAI guidelines.
facts.display: Yes, apply 30 to 60 days before renewal; waiting-period credit carried
facts.note: Migration to other ManipalCigna products also allowed, applying at least 30 days before renewal.
facts.quote: The Insured Person will have the option to port the Policy to otherinsurers by applying to such insurer to port the entire policy along with all the members of the family, if any, at least 30 days before, but not earlier than 60 days from the policy renewal date as per IRDAI Guidelines related to portability. If such person is presently covered and has been continuously covered without any lapses under any health insurance plan with an Indian General/Health insurer the proposed Insured Person will get the accrued continuity benefits in waiting periods as per IRDAI Guidelines on portability.

facts.label: Cancellation by you
facts.value: Policyholder can cancel with 7 days' written notice. 1-year policy: proportionate refund for unexpired days if no claim, no refund if a claim was made. Longer policies: proportionate refund if no claim in the current policy year; if a claim was made in the current year, refund of premium for the remaining complete policy years. No refund if the insurer cancels for misrepresentation, non-disclosure or fraud.
facts.display: Pro-rata for unexpired days if no claim; no refund on a 1-year policy after a claim
facts.note: A claim in an earlier policy year of a multi-year policy still gets a proportionate refund.
facts.quote: The policyholder may cancel this policy by giving 7 days written notice ... A. Policy Tenure of 1 Year: 1. If no claim has been made during the policy period, a proportionate refund of the premium will be issued based on the number of unexpired days. ... 2. If a claim has been made during the Policy period, no refund will be given to the Policyholder. ... B. If Policy Tenure is more than 1 years: 1. If no claim has been made in the policy year, a proportionate refund of the premium on cancellation will be issued based on the number of unexpired days. ... 2. If a claim has been made in the current policy year, the premium for the remaining complete policy year(s) will be refunded on cancellation. ... There would be no refund of premium on cancellation on grounds of misrepresentation, non-disclosure of material facts or fraud
